description: A single bare 'en' catalog with a French fallback. Every en-REGIONAL range therefore relates to it only through CLDR fallback, which is the one anchor category that is NOT eligible for q=0 exclusion, and en-GB and en-AU relate to it with identical specificity. That is the configuration the governor and anchor sweeps need: two equally specific anchors on one locale, whose competition can only be decided by weight and then by request order.
